title: Deploy to a robot on the field
summary: Take your turn on a real robot through the Field Gateway: get in line, deploy your code, drive it, and give it back.

say.never: Your code can run on a **real robot** on the field, not just the simulator. Look at the row of icons down the left side of the Driver Station, the strip at the bottom. The **rocket** is the **Robot tab**. Click it. You'll see **ROBOTS ON THE FIELD**: each real robot, who is using it, and how many people are waiting. A green **Field Gateway** light means the field is ready for you.
say.bit: The **rocket** on the left of the Driver Station opens the **Robot tab**: the real robots on the field, who has each one, and the line. Green **Field Gateway** means the field is ready.

hint.never: click the rocket icon to open the Robot tab.

say.never: Press **JOIN** on the robot your mentor gives you. If someone else has it, you're **in line** ("You're #2"): keep coding and using the simulator, and Scriptum tells you when it's your turn. When the robot says **yours**, press **DEPLOY**. The Field Gateway builds your code and copies it onto the robot, and you can watch its 10 steps tick off here, with its output in **Console Output**. If a step fails, a card says which step broke and what to do: read it, fix your code, and press **DEPLOY** again.
say.bit: **JOIN** the robot your mentor gives you (you may be in line; keep coding). When it's **yours**, press **DEPLOY** and watch the 10 steps. If one fails, its card says what broke and what to do; fix it and **DEPLOY** again.

say.never: Your code is on the robot. Drive it with **your team's Driver Station on the field**. During **Shop Time**, your Driver Station enables and disables your own robot, and the **spacebar** is the emergency stop. When you're done, press **RELEASE** so the next person gets a turn. The robot's logs (`.wpilog` and `.btlog` files) are copied into your lesson's **logs/** folder, in a folder named for your turn (like `logs/11-08_1530-team4143/`).
say.bit: Drive with your team's Driver Station on the field (in **Shop Time** it enables your robot; **spacebar** = emergency stop). Press **RELEASE** when done; the robot's logs land in **logs/**.
